title: Highly recommend this small group sail and cocktail workshop. Informative and fun!
text: Highly recommend this cocktail and sunset cruise in Barcelona. John is an extraordinary mixologist who puts together a truly interesting and exciting evening. Albert, our captain, was very nice, helpful and  funny. We sailed with a couple we did not know and had a great time.  It’s is small group excursion that is truly relaxing and enjoyable.   Barcelona looks beautiful from the sea at sunset.

title: Amazing drinks and sunset views!
text: We had a great cocktail host and captain. Both were very friendly and got to enjoy making amazing, unique cocktails on the boat with a wide variety of snacks before. We enjoyed a great tour of the harbor by the captain and left the bay to see the sunset around us. They took great pictures of us and gave us great Barcelona recommendations for food/drink after the tour as well as places to go. I would high;y recommend this for couples or for a group of 3+ friends.
